description: Emails tomorrow's calendar events to one recipient, defaulting to the script owner's own address. Add a morning time-driven trigger for a daily agenda.
setup: Create a script project and copy in Code.gs and appsscript.json.
Optionally set Script Properties: AGENDA_RECIPIENT, AGENDA_CALENDAR.
Run sendDailyAgenda() once and check the inbox and execution log.
Add a morning time-driven trigger for a daily agenda.
title: Calendar Daily Agenda
